entries: **The menu bar app uses about half the memory and far less CPU per refresh.** Measured on one machine with 1.6 GB of Claude logs and 596 MB of Codex logs: the memory footprint went from 263 MB to about 130 MB, and each refresh from 1.2–1.65 s of CPU to 0.16–0.47 s. Grok's `updates.jsonl` lines are JSON-decoded only when they carry `costUsdTicks` (212 of 22,491 lines), and the whole Grok result is reused while none of its files change. The history cache drops lines repeated within one Claude log (57% of cached entries), shares repeated model, project and session strings, and skips entries whose source file was deleted; only the cache shards that changed are rewritten. Today's and yesterday's totals compare against local day boundaries instead of converting every entry's time zone, and the source scan groups paths by their parts. The first launch after upgrading re-reads the Claude logs once to rebuild the cache.

**Generating the HTML report again no longer re-reads every log.** The report's parsers capped their file cache at 512, below a real install's file count, so a sequential scan evicted every file; the cap is now 4096, as in the menu bar's loader. A second load went from 5.0 s to 0.1 s.

**Claude spending is no longer undercounted after the app restarts.** The on-disk cache dropped the count of 1-hour cache writes, so after a restart they were priced as 5-minute writes (1.25× input instead of 2×). `usage doctor`'s reconciliation against Claude Code's own cost went from 12% apart to 2%. The Claude cache schema was bumped, so existing caches rebuild with the right figures.

**Turning the status line off and on no longer loses the status line you had before installing usage.** The switch parked the live status line under `previousStatusLine`, the key that holds the pre-install backup, so a later uninstall had nothing to restore. It now uses its own key, and uninstalling while the switch is off restores the original too.
**Uninstalling restores the Antigravity status line.** `usage unsetup` restored Claude Code, Codex and Grok but left Antigravity pointing at usage's script.
**Several directories in `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` no longer stop the menu bar from refreshing.** The history scan assumed exactly one Claude directory and crashed when a comma-separated list named more.

**A setting changed during an update check is no longer reverted.** The background update check saved the preferences it had read before its network request, overwriting anything changed meanwhile; on macOS and Windows it now re-reads them first.

**The terse-mode and session-resume hooks' built-in fallback text matches the translations.** The fallbacks, shown only when the translation sidecar is missing, had fallen behind `i18n.json`; the English terse reminder also gets back the verb in "Drop filler … and pleasantries". Both hook versions were bumped so installed copies are rewritten.
**CI checks formatting with `ruff format --check`.** The whole project was reformatted once, and that commit is listed in `.git-blame-ignore-revs`.
**The daylight-saving title test passes Windows' type check.** It calls `time.tzset` through `getattr`, since Windows has no `tzset`.

**Website on phones.** Chinese and Japanese paragraphs are no longer justified at 640px and below, the Homebrew command fits on one line in the install card, and Windows visitors see the Windows download button first.

Grok's `updates.jsonl` lines are JSON-decoded only when they carry `costUsdTicks` (212 of 22,491 lines), and the whole Grok result is reused while none of its files change. title.zh-TW: 重新開啟 App 不再少算 Claude 花費，快取寫入計價回歸正確倍率
title.en: Reopening app no longer undercounts Claude spending, cache write pricing returns to correct multiplier

body.zh-TW: 重啟電腦或重新打開 usage 後，你看到的 Claude 花費不會再少算。以前程式將資料寫入硬碟快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）時，漏掉了「1 小時快取寫入」的筆數。這導致 App 重開後，這批寫入被誤當成費率較低的 5 分鐘快取計價（以輸入價格的 1.25 倍而非正確的 2 倍計算），算出來的花費因而偏低。用 `usage doctor` 跟 Claude Code 自己算的花費對帳，差距從 12% 降到 2%。Claude 的快取結構已升級，現有快取會以正確的倍率重新計算。⟦就像飯店櫃台的電腦重開機後，以前會把住一晚的客人誤登成鐘點休息，帳因此少算一截；現在重開機也會照原本登記的方案收費。⟧
body.en: After restarting your computer or reopening usage, the Claude spending you see is no longer undercounted. Previously, when writing data to disk cache, the program dropped the count of "1-hour cache writes". This caused the app, upon reopening, to mistakenly price these writes at the lower 5-minute cache rate (calculated at 1.25× the input price instead of the correct 2×), resulting in undercounted spending. Reconciling with `usage doctor` against Claude Code's own cost figures, the gap went from 12% to 2%. The Claude cache structure was upgraded, so existing caches recalculate with the correct multiplier. ⟦It is like a hotel front-desk system that, after a reboot, used to log overnight guests as short hourly stays and undercharge them; now it keeps charging the plan each guest actually booked.⟧

items.original: **Claude spending is no longer undercounted after the app restarts.** The on-disk cache dropped the count of 1-hour cache writes, so after a restart they were priced as 5-minute writes (1.25× input instead of 2×). `usage doctor`'s reconciliation against Claude Code's own cost went from 12% apart to 2%. The Claude cache schema was bumped, so existing caches rebuild with the right figures.

title.zh-TW: 解除安裝完整還原原本的狀態列，開關切換不再覆寫原始備份
title.en: Uninstalling fully restores the original status line, toggle switch no longer overwrites original backup

body.zh-TW: 你在安裝 usage 之前自己設定的狀態列，現在不會再被弄丟。以前在設定中關閉再開啟狀態列，程式會把當前的狀態列暫存在專門保存安裝前備份的欄位 `previousStatusLine`，導致原本的舊設定被蓋掉，日後解除安裝時找不到最初的設定值。現在開關改用獨立欄位儲存，即使在狀態列關閉的狀態下解除安裝，也能順利找回原本的設定。執行 `usage unsetup` 解除安裝時，除了還原 Claude Code、Codex 與 Grok 之外，現在也會一併還原 Antigravity 的狀態列，不再將其遺留在 usage 的腳本捷徑上。⟦租車出遊換上自己的導航架，還車拆下時車行依舊把原廠螢幕接回，不會因為中途切換過模式就弄丟原本的配備。⟧
body.en: The status line you set up before installing usage is no longer lost. Previously, toggling the status line off and on in settings caused the program to park the active status line under `previousStatusLine`, a field reserved for the pre-installation backup, which overwrote the original configuration and left uninstallation with nothing to restore. Toggling now stores state in an independent field, successfully restoring your original settings even if you uninstall while the status line is turned off. When running `usage unsetup` to uninstall, in addition to restoring Claude Code, Codex, and Grok, it now also restores Antigravity's status line instead of leaving it pointing at usage's script shortcut. ⟦Picture installing your own navigation mount in a rental car; when returning the car and taking it down, the agency still hooks the factory screen back up without losing the original gear just because you switched modes during the trip.⟧

items.original:
**Turning the status line off and on no longer loses the status line you had before installing usage.** The switch parked the live status line under `previousStatusLine`, the key that holds the pre-install backup, so a later uninstall had nothing to restore. It now uses its own key, and uninstalling while the switch is off restores the original too.
**Uninstalling restores the Antigravity status line.** `usage unsetup` restored Claude Code, Codex and Grok but left Antigravity pointing at usage's script.

title.zh-TW: 支援多個 Claude 目錄掃描，修復背景更新覆寫設定與 Hook 備援文字
title.en: Scanning multiple Claude directories supported, background update overwriting settings and hook fallback text fixed

body.zh-TW: 如果你平時會在多個環境目錄切換，或習慣一邊檢查軟體更新一邊調整偏好，日常操作現在更加穩定順手。當你在環境變數 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 中用逗號指定多個資料夾時，歷史紀錄掃描不再因預設單一路徑而當掉，選單列能持續正常刷新。背景檢查更新時，程式在連網結束後會先重新讀取最新的設定檔，解決 macOS 與 Windows 上剛改好的設定會被連網前的舊資料覆蓋回去的問題。精簡模式與接續工作階段的 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）在遺失翻譯檔時顯示的內建備援文字，已同步至最新 `i18n.json` 內容。英文精簡提醒也補回「Drop filler … and pleasantries」的動詞。兩支 hook 均已升級版本並會自動重寫本機副本。多專案切換與自訂偏好設定的使用者，從此不必再擔心設定被莫名還原或畫面停止更新。
body.en: If you frequently switch between multiple environment directories or adjust preferences while checking for software updates, daily workflows are now smoother and more reliable. When you specify multiple folders separated by commas in the `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` environment variable, history scans no longer crash by assuming a single path, allowing the menu bar to refresh normally. During background update checks, the program now re-reads the latest preferences after the network request finishes, fixing an issue on macOS and Windows where freshly updated settings were overwritten by stale pre-network data. The built-in fallback text shown by terse-mode and session-resume hooks (small programs triggered when specific events occur) when translation files are missing has been synchronized with the latest `i18n.json`. The English terse reminder also restores the verb in "Drop filler … and pleasantries". Both hook versions were bumped and will automatically rewrite local copies. Users switching across projects and customizing preferences no longer need to worry about settings unexpectedly reverting or displays freezing.

items.original:
**Several directories in `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` no longer stop the menu bar from refreshing.** The history scan assumed exactly one Claude directory and crashed when a comma-separated list named more.
**A setting changed during an update check is no longer reverted.** The background update check saved the preferences it had read before its network request, overwriting anything changed meanwhile; on macOS and Windows it now re-reads them first.
**The terse-mode and session-resume hooks' built-in fallback text matches the translations.** The fallbacks, shown only when the translation sidecar is missing, had fallen behind `i18n.json`; the English terse reminder also gets back the verb in "Drop filler … and pleasantries". Both hook versions were bumped so installed copies are rewritten.

title.zh-TW: 官網手機版排版優化，CI 導入 Ruff 檢查並修復 Windows 測試
title.en: Official website mobile layout polished, CI adopts Ruff formatting check and Windows tests fixed

body.zh-TW: 用手機瀏覽 usage 官方網站，或是在不同作業系統參與專案開發時，閱讀與測試體驗都更為清爽。官網在 640px 以下的手機螢幕上，中日文段落取消了兩端對齊排版，讓窄螢幕閱讀更自然。安裝卡片內的 Homebrew 安裝指令現在能完整在一行內放下，而 Windows 訪客打開首頁時也會優先看到專屬的下載按鈕。在內部維護方面，持續整合（CI，自動驗證程式碼的機制）導入了 `ruff format --check` 檢查程式碼排版，全專案重排的紀錄也已收錄在 `.git-blame-ignore-revs` 中，讓 `git blame` 不會把每一行都算到這次重排頭上。夏令時間標題測試改用 `getattr` 呼叫 `time.tzset`，順利解決 Windows 系統因缺乏該函式而無法通過型別檢查的困擾。
body.en: Whether browsing the official usage website on mobile or contributing across different operating systems, reading and testing experiences are now much cleaner. On mobile screens at 640px and below, the website removes justified text alignment for Chinese and Japanese paragraphs, making narrow-screen reading more natural. The Homebrew install command inside the install card now fits cleanly on a single line, and Windows visitors opening the homepage see the dedicated Windows download button first. For internal maintenance, continuous integration (CI, an automated mechanism for verifying code) introduced `ruff format --check` to verify code formatting, and the commit for reformatting the entire project is recorded in `.git-blame-ignore-revs` so `git blame` does not attribute every line to that reformat. The daylight-saving title test now calls `time.tzset` via `getattr`, resolving type-checking failures on Windows due to the missing function.

items.original:
**CI checks formatting with `ruff format --check`.** The whole project was reformatted once, and that commit is listed in `.git-blame-ignore-revs`.
**The daylight-saving title test passes Windows' type check.** It calls `time.tzset` through `getattr`, since Windows has no `tzset`.
**Website on phones.** Chinese and Japanese paragraphs are no longer justified at 640px and below, the Homebrew command fits on one line in the install card, and Windows visitors see the Windows download button first.

entries: **New app icon: a flat ink-wash cat.** Every icon is now generated from one set of SVG sources in `assets/brand/` (color, black, reversed, wordmark, app icon) by `scripts/make_app_icon.py`: the macOS and Windows app icons, the README avatar, the website favicon, apple-touch-icon and logo banner. The app icon follows Apple's grid as a rounded square, so macOS 26 and 27 no longer put it inside a gray frame.

**Opus 5.5 has an offline price and a short name.** Claude Code 2.1.280 made Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) the default Opus model, but the fallback price table had no entry for it, so whenever the price cache had expired its usage was costed at $0. The table now carries $4/$20 per Mtok with $5 cache writes and $0.20 cache reads, matching LiteLLM, and the usage table shows "Opus 5.5" instead of the raw model ID.

**Grok spending is recovered when `unified.jsonl` is missing.** A missing combined log returned an empty list, so the per-session `updates.jsonl` spending was dropped too. It is now handled like an empty combined log and recovered as before.

**Website: first-launch guide and live star count.** The install section explains what to do when macOS blocks the first launch (from macOS 15, right-click → Open no longer bypasses Gatekeeper; use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway), linked from under the hero download button, and all five READMEs describe the same steps. The Star on GitHub button shows the live star count and hides it if the request fails. Titles mention Grok, theme screenshots are WebP (647KB → 95KB on the English page), and non-English pages carry their own URL, language and description in JSON-LD.

**Website: CJK typography follows W3C clreq.** Chinese, Japanese and Korean pages use zero heading letter-spacing, break Chinese headings only between words, keep em dashes off the start of a line, and use larger text and line height in the install cards. Justified paragraphs were reverted to normal line breaking after they opened wide gaps in the hero text. English pages are unchanged.

**Website: the logo's red circle animates.** In the header it draws in on load and shrinks as you read down the page, the copy button closes its small circle on success, a faint large circle turns behind the hero title, and a new 404 page switches among the five languages. All motion is off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
**The header mark, social preview image and section tabs use the new icon and a cleaner layout.** The unused butler-cat `docs/avatar.png` was removed.

title.en: Opus 5.5 adds offline fallback pricing, usage table switches to short name

body.zh-TW: 平時使用 Claude Code 呼叫最新的預設模型，現在離線也能算出正確花費。從 Claude Code 2.1.280 開始，Opus 5.5（`claude-opus-5-5`）已成為預設的 Opus 模型。然而先前的離線備援價目表遺漏了這筆資料，導致價格快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）一旦過期，該模型的花費就會被錯誤算成 $0。現在價目表已補上每百萬 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）輸入 $4、輸出 $20、快取寫入 $5 與快取讀取 $0.20 的定價，標準與 LiteLLM 完全一致。用量報表中的欄位也改為直接顯示「Opus 5.5」，不再印出冗長的原始識別碼。⟦計程車跳表機預載了最新的夜間加成費率表，就算開進收不到訊號的地下道，也能照常按新費率精準計費。⟧
body.en: Calling the latest default model in Claude Code now computes accurate costs even offline. Since Claude Code 2.1.280, Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) has been the default Opus model. However, the previous offline fallback price table omitted this entry, causing the model's cost to be wrongly calculated as $0 whenever the price cache expired. The price table now includes pricing of $4 input, $20 output, $5 cache writes, and $0.20 cache reads per million tokens, matching LiteLLM exactly. Columns in usage reports also directly display "Opus 5.5" instead of printing the lengthy raw identifier. ⟦Like a taxi meter preloaded with the latest night-surcharge rates, pricing remains accurate even when driving into an underpass with no signal.⟧

items.original: **Opus 5.5 has an offline price and a short name.** Claude Code 2.1.280 made Opus 5.5 (`claude-opus-5-5`) the default Opus model, but the fallback price table had no entry for it, so whenever the price cache had expired its usage was costed at $0. The table now carries $4/$20 per Mtok with $5 cache writes and $0.20 cache reads, matching LiteLLM, and the usage table shows "Opus 5.5" instead of the raw model ID.

title.zh-TW: Grok 缺少總紀錄檔時，各工作階段花費照常自動補回
title.en: Grok per-session spending is recovered automatically when combined log is missing

body.zh-TW: 查詢 Grok 的使用花費時，就算總紀錄檔尚未建立也不必擔心資料遺失。在先前的機制中，當總彙整檔 `unified.jsonl` 不存在時，系統會直接回傳空清單，導致個別工作階段在 `updates.jsonl` 裡記錄的花費跟著全部丟失。現在程式會將「檔案不存在」比照「檔案內容為空」來處理，照常從各工作階段的日誌中將花費完整補回，確保統計數據不會漏算。⟦抄表員發現社區總電表尚未安裝，便逐一抄下各分戶的獨立電表，依然能把整棟樓的用電度數完整拼湊回來。⟧
body.en: Checking Grok spending no longer risks losing data even if the combined log has not been created yet. Under the previous mechanism, when the combined log file `unified.jsonl` did not exist, the system returned an empty list, causing all spending recorded by individual sessions in `updates.jsonl` to be lost. The program now treats a non-existent file the same as an empty file, fully recovering spending from individual session logs as usual and ensuring statistics are never undercounted. ⟦Picture a meter reader who discovers the building's master electric meter is not yet installed and reads each individual apartment meter instead, completely piecing together the power usage.⟧

items.original: **Grok spending is recovered when `unified.jsonl` is missing.** A missing combined log returned an empty list, so the per-session `updates.jsonl` spending was dropped too. It is now handled like an empty combined log and recovered as before.

title.zh-TW: 官網新增首次安裝指引，校正中日韓文字排版與動態細節
title.en: Website adds first-launch guide, CJK typography fixes, and animated details

body.zh-TW: 造訪 usage 官網時，現在能看到更清晰的指引與細緻動態。安裝區說明 macOS 15 起無法以右鍵打開繞過 Gatekeeper，需至「系統設定」→「隱私權與安全性」點選「強制打開」，首頁下載鈕下方與五份 README 同步附上說明。GitHub 按鈕顯示即時星星數，抓取失敗時自動隱藏，標題補上 Grok。主題截圖改 WebP（英文頁 647KB 降至 95KB），非英文頁的 JSON-LD 帶入專屬網址、語言與描述。中日韓頁依 W3C clreq 校正：標題字距歸零、中文標題僅在詞間斷行、破折號不落行首，安裝卡文字與行距放大，首屏說明改回一般斷行以消除兩端對齊拉出的過大空隙，英文頁不變。頁首紅圈載入時一筆畫出並隨閱讀縮短，複製成功補滿小紅圈，首屏標題後方有淡紅圈旋轉，並新增五語 404 頁；`prefers-reduced-motion` 下所有動畫關閉。
body.en: Visiting the usage website now presents clearer guidance and refined animations. The install section explains that from macOS 15 onward, right-click Open no longer bypasses Gatekeeper, requiring users to go to System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway; these instructions are linked below the hero download button and across all five READMEs. The GitHub button shows a live star count and automatically hides if fetching fails, with Grok added to titles. Theme screenshots switch to WebP (dropping from 647KB to 95KB on the English page), and non-English pages populate their own URL, language, and description in JSON-LD. CJK pages follow W3C clreq corrections: heading letter-spacing is zeroed, Chinese headings break only between words, em dashes never start a line, install card text and line height are enlarged, and hero text reverts to standard line breaks to eliminate oversized gaps caused by justified alignment, leaving English pages unchanged. The header's red circle draws in on load and shrinks as you scroll down, the copy button fills in a small red circle on success, a faint red circle rotates behind the hero title, and new 404 pages cover five languages; all animations are disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

items.original:
**Website: first-launch guide and live star count.** The install section explains what to do when macOS blocks the first launch (from macOS 15, right-click → Open no longer bypasses Gatekeeper; use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway), linked from under the hero download button, and all five READMEs describe the same steps. The Star on GitHub button shows the live star count and hides it if the request fails. Titles mention Grok, theme screenshots are WebP (647KB → 95KB on the English page), and non-English pages carry their own URL, language and description in JSON-LD.
**Website: CJK typography follows W3C clreq.** Chinese, Japanese and Korean pages use zero heading letter-spacing, break Chinese headings only between words, keep em dashes off the start of a line, and use larger text and line height in the install cards. Justified paragraphs were reverted to normal line breaking after they opened wide gaps in the hero text. English pages are unchanged.
**Website: the logo's red circle animates.** In the header it draws in on load and shrinks as you read down the page, the copy button closes its small circle on success, a faint large circle turns behind the hero title, and a new 404 page switches among the five languages. All motion is off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

entries: **The HTML report is laid out as dashboard cards.** Each section sits in a card of the same shape instead of being split by thin rules, which were hard to follow down a long page. Body text and numbers share one sans-serif face with tabular figures; monospace is kept for the `[usage]>` prefix and the command line at the top. The palette is neutral, token counts are no longer amber, and green is kept for trends and peaks. The four summary cards share one three-row grid, so their numbers line up.

**Chart labels in the HTML report are larger.** Axis labels went from 9px to 12px and legends from .7rem to .8rem, and the hour axis and the heatmap's month and weekday labels grew with them. The old sizes were unreadable on an ordinary screen.

**Switching Claude accounts no longer shows the previous account's quota on Windows.** Claude Code tags the quota it caches in `~/.claude.json` with the account that fetched it and ignores the cache after a switch. usage did not check the tag, and on Windows that cache is the main source of Claude quota. A cache from another account is now skipped. Caches written by older Claude Code versions carry no tag and are still read.

**Report tests pin session start times to UTC.** Six report tests passed only on UTC machines, so CI stayed green while they failed on Windows at UTC+8. Session start times were converted with an inline `.astimezone()` the tests could not replace; that conversion is now `_session_start_text()`, and the fixtures pin it to UTC next to `_entry_date`. Behavior is unchanged. (#144)

**Website visual refresh.** The feature section alternates image and text in three rows (quota for every tool, the HTML report, themes) with the remaining features as two-column cards, and the standalone report section merged into the second row. The pacing section is a paper card, the theme preview sizes its frame to the panel so short panels leave no empty space, and install moved to the end. Nav links, the mobile copy button and footer links have larger tap targets, and panel previews show a static poster until they load, in Chinese on the Chinese pages.

title.zh-TW: HTML 報表換新版面，圖表文字從 9px 放大到 12px
title.en: The HTML report gets a new layout, with chart text up from 9px to 12px

body.zh-TW: 打開 usage 產出的 HTML 報表，現在每個區塊都收進外框一致的儀表板卡片裡。以前整頁報表只靠細線分段，頁面一長很難看清哪裡是哪裡；現在上方四張摘要卡共用同一個三列格線，數字整齊切齊。內文與數值一律換成無襯線字體配等寬數字，等寬字體只留給頂部的指令與 `[usage]>` 前綴。整體色調轉為中性，token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量不再是土黃色，綠色則專門留給趨勢與尖峰。圖表上的文字也同步變大，坐標軸標籤從 9px 放大到 12px、圖例從 .7rem 放大到 .8rem，時段軸與熱力圖的月份及星期標籤都變大了，解決以前在普通螢幕上看不清的困擾。⟦就像展覽的導覽手冊，以前整本只用幾條細線隔開長篇文字，現在改成一張張分好類的解說牌，字也印大了，站遠一點也看得清。⟧
body.en: When you open the HTML report generated by usage, each section is now neatly organized inside a consistent dashboard card. Previously, the entire report was split only by thin divider lines, making it hard to navigate down a long page; now the four summary cards at the top share a single three-row grid, keeping numbers aligned. Body text and numbers uniformly share a sans-serif typeface paired with tabular figures, keeping monospace only for the command line at the top and the `[usage]>` prefix. The color palette shifted to neutral tones, token counts are no longer amber, and green is reserved exclusively for trends and peaks. Chart text is also larger: axis labels grew from 9px to 12px, legends grew from .7rem to .8rem, and the hour axis alongside the heatmap's month and weekday labels were also enlarged, fixing the previous issue where text was unreadable on ordinary screens. ⟦Think of an exhibition guide that used to separate long passages with a few thin lines and now uses sorted display plaques in bigger print, readable from a step back.⟧

title.zh-TW: Windows 上切換 Claude 帳號不再殘留前一個人的額度
title.en: Switching Claude accounts on Windows no longer shows previous quota

body.zh-TW: 家裡或公司共用一台 Windows 電腦，各自登入不同的 Claude 帳號？Claude Code 會把查到的用量額度存在 `~/.claude.json` 檔案中，並在快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）裡標註抓取時的帳號名稱；只要一換帳號，Claude Code 就會自動忽略該筆暫存。以前 usage 讀取檔案時沒有檢查這個帳號標籤，而 Windows 上查詢 Claude 額度又主要仰賴這份快取，才導致換了帳號卻依然顯示前一位使用者的剩餘用量。現在只要發現帳號不符就會主動跳過該快取；至於舊版 Claude Code 寫入、沒有帶帳號標籤的快取資料，依然會正常讀取。⟦像到洗衣店取件，店員會先核對單據上的名字，名字不是你，就不會把上一位客人的衣服交給你。⟧
body.en: Sharing one Windows PC and signing in to different Claude accounts? Claude Code stores retrieved quota in `~/.claude.json` and tags the cache (temporary storage for fetched results) with the account name that retrieved it, automatically ignoring the cache whenever the account switches. Previously, usage did not verify this account tag, and Windows relies primarily on this cache file for Claude quota, causing the tool to keep displaying the previous user's remaining balance after a switch. Now, any cache with a mismatched account is skipped; caches written by older Claude Code versions without account tags continue to be read normally. ⟦Picture a dry cleaner who checks the name on every ticket, so you never walk out with the previous customer's clothes.⟧

A cache from another account is now skipped. Caches written by older Claude Code versions carry no tag and are still read.

title.zh-TW: 報表測試時間一律固定為 UTC，排除時區不同造成的驗證失敗
title.en: Report tests pin session start times to UTC to avoid time zone failures

body.zh-TW: 這是給開發者的修正，一般使用者不會感覺到差別。以前有 6 支報表測試只能在時區設為 UTC 的電腦上通過，導致線上持續整合（CI，自動驗證程式的機制）明明是綠燈，開發者在 UTC+8 的 Windows 電腦上跑測試卻固定失敗。這是因為程式先前直接在行內轉換工作階段的開始時間，測試環境沒辦法把時間固定住；現在這段時間轉換邏輯獨立了出來，讓測試能把時間基準牢牢鎖在 UTC，軟體本身的功能與行為則完全維持不變。⟦跨國線上大考一律以格林威治標準時間出題與收卷，不再拿各地考生的手錶時間當標準，評分就不會因為考生住在不同時區而判錯。⟧
body.en: This one is for developers; as a user you won't notice a difference. Previously, 6 report tests passed only on machines configured for the UTC time zone, so continuous integration (CI) stayed green while tests consistently failed on Windows machines in UTC+8. This happened because the code converted session start times inline where test fixtures could not freeze the clock; that conversion logic is now separated out so tests can pin the reference time directly to UTC, while the software's functional behavior remains completely unchanged. ⟦An international exam that syncs every clock to GMT grades everyone against the same time, not against each student's wristwatch.⟧

items.original: **Report tests pin session start times to UTC.** Six report tests passed only on UTC machines, so CI stayed green while they failed on Windows at UTC+8. Session start times were converted with an inline `.astimezone()` the tests could not replace; that conversion is now `_session_start_text()`, and the fixtures pin it to UTC next to `_entry_date`. Behavior is unchanged. (#144)

title.zh-TW: 官網視覺排版重整，手機更好點按並加入面板預載圖
title.en: Website visual redesign with larger tap targets and preloaded panel posters

body.zh-TW: 逛 usage 官方網站時，現在用手機點選連結或按鈕順手多了。首頁功能區改用三排圖文左右交錯呈現，分別介紹各工具額度、HTML 報表與外觀主題，其餘功能則整理成雙欄卡片，原本獨立的報表區塊也直接併入第二排。進度管家改採紙卡質感呈現，主題預覽外框會跟著面板高度自動縮放，短面板下方不再留下一大塊尷尬空白，安裝教學則移到頁面最下方。⟦翻開重新裝訂的產品型錄，主力商品圖文並茂排在最前頭，其餘項目整齊收進小格子，按鈕也加大防誤觸，讀起來清爽多了。⟧頂部導覽列、手機複製按鈕與頁尾連結都放大了點擊有效範圍，而且面板預覽在載入完成前會先顯示靜態預載海報，中文網頁也配上中文版海報。
body.en: Browsing the usage official website on a mobile phone is now much easier on your fingers. The homepage feature section now alternates image and text across three rows to present tool quotas, HTML reports, and visual themes, while secondary features are arranged into two-column cards, and the standalone report section is merged into the second row. The pacing section adopts a paper card look, the theme preview frame dynamically fits panel height so shorter panels leave no awkward empty space, and installation instructions moved to the very bottom. ⟦It reads like a redesigned product brochure: main items get prominent spreads, the rest sit in tidy boxes, and the buttons are bigger and harder to miss.⟧ Navigation links, the mobile copy button, and footer links all feature larger tap target areas, and panel previews display a static poster image until fully loaded, with Chinese posters served on Chinese pages.

items.original: **Website visual refresh.** The feature section alternates image and text in three rows (quota for every tool, the HTML report, themes) with the remaining features as two-column cards, and the standalone report section merged into the second row. The pacing section is a paper card, the theme preview sizes its frame to the panel so short panels leave no empty space, and install moved to the end. Nav links, the mobile copy button and footer links have larger tap targets, and panel previews show a static poster until they load, in Chinese on the Chinese pages.

entries: **Insights now sit directly under the summary cards, tagged "Fixed range".** They used to come after the heatmap, habits and recent work, around 3,600px down a 4,660px page, so the most actionable line was the last thing anyone read. Insights cover the whole report period and do not follow the date filter, which is what the tag says.

**The "How these numbers are calculated" appendix moved above the "The sections below don't follow the date filter above" note.** The appendix does follow the filter (cache reads went from 5.29B to 1.88B after picking Last 7 days), so the note was wrong about it.

**The date filter only stays pinned while the sections it controls are on screen.** Scrolling into the heatmap, habits, recent work and Wrapped now lets it scroll away instead of offering buttons that change nothing there.

**Top 5 burn sessions are ranked by tokens.** They were sorted by cost while their bars, and every other "burn" in the report, measure tokens, so the second row could carry a longer bar than the first. Cost breaks ties.

**Projects use one neutral colour.** They borrowed the tools' green, purple and orange, so a project could look like it belonged to Claude Code, Antigravity or Codex. Grok's bar in the tools list is now the same pink as the chart; it was still teal there.
**Active days reads "17 / 17 days" instead of "17/17"**, which looked like a date next to the peak-day card.

**Top sessions no longer hide tokens and cost off-screen on phones.** Each session is now a card with project, tokens and cost on the first line, start time and duration on the second, model on the third.
**Buttons and links are at least 44px tall on screens 780px wide or narrower.** The range buttons, date inputs, theme and share buttons, the Tokens/Cost toggle and the footer links were 16 to 32px.
**Dates and model names no longer break at a hyphen on phones.** The header period and the summary sentence split `2026-05-` from `04`.
**"Share of project" is shown once per expanded project** instead of on every model row.
**The cache hit rate explanation sits under its own heading** instead of directly below the Output row.
**The empty report names Antigravity and Grok** alongside Claude Code and Codex, in all five languages.
**The footer has one Ko-fi link instead of two.**

**Each website language has its own page** (`/zh-TW/`, `/zh-CN/`, `/ja/`, `/ko/`) with its own title, `html lang` and canonical, generated from `docs/index.html` by `scripts/build_site_pages.py`; CI runs it with `--check`. Every `?lang=` URL used to serve the English HTML with an English canonical, so the other four languages could not be indexed. hreflang and the sitemap list all five, and old `?lang=` links still work.
**The website's feature section is a card grid with icons, and the headline includes Grok.**

**Website accessibility and mobile fixes from Lighthouse, axe and the Vercel Web Interface Guidelines.** The mobile section menu closes after a tap, hero images ship 800w and 1200w variants (about 230KB less on phones), install commands are marked `translate="no"`, and scrollable regions are keyboard-reachable.
**Website typography.** Headings balance across lines, paragraphs avoid one-word last lines, Japanese and Korean headings no longer break mid-word, and inline commands no longer split at hyphens.
**Report screenshots retaken** for the new layout.

title.zh-TW: 洞察結論移至摘要卡正下方，日期篩選列隨管轄區塊動態吸頂
title.en: Insights Move Right Under the Summary Cards, Date Filter Now Only Pins Above Sections It Actually Controls

body.zh-TW: 檢視用量報表時，最關鍵的洞察結論不再需要滑到頁面底部。過去長達 4,660px 的頁面中，洞察排在熱力圖、使用習慣與最近在做什麼之後，要捲動到約 3,600px 處才看得見。現在洞察移至數字卡片正下方並標上「固定區間」，表示它統計整份報告期間、不跟日期篩選連動。「數字怎麼算的」附錄移到「以下區塊不受上方日期篩選影響」上方，因附錄數據會隨篩選改變（選「最近 7 天」後快取讀取量由 5.29B 變成 1.88B）。日期篩選列改為只在管轄區塊在畫面時固定在頂端，捲到熱力圖、使用習慣、最近在做什麼與年度 Wrapped 時會跟著離開，不再留下一排按了沒反應的按鈕。⟦這好比商場將導覽指引立在手扶梯旁，促銷標籤只在特賣區懸浮，走進常設專櫃便自動收起。⟧

On the old 4,660px page, Insights came after the heatmap, habits, and recent work, around 3,600px down. Insights now sits directly under the summary cards, tagged "Fixed range" to show it covers the whole report period and doesn't follow the date filter. The date filter now only stays pinned while the sections it controls are on screen; scrolling into the heatmap, habits, recent work, or Wrapped lets it scroll away instead of leaving a row of buttons that do nothing there. ⟦It's like a mall putting directional signage next to the escalator, with promo tags floating only over the sale section and folding away once you walk into the permanent stores.⟧

title.zh-TW: 高消耗工作階段改依 tokens 排序，專案改採中性色並調整指標排版
title.en: Top Burn Sessions Now Rank by Tokens, Projects Get a Neutral Colour and Metrics Get Tidier

body.zh-TW: 想掌握各個模型與專案的消耗排行，圖表與數據呈現現在更加直覺一致。過去「最燒的 5 段工作階段」依花費排序，但長條圖與報表各處的燃燒皆代表 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），導致第二名長條可能比第一名還長。現在全面改依 token 排序，用量相同時才比花費。專案長條改用單一中性色，不再借用工具的綠、紫、橘色，避免專案看起來像屬於 Claude Code、Antigravity 或 Codex；工具列中 Grok 的長條也改為與圖表相同的粉紅色。活躍日寫成「17 / 17 天」，避免在尖峰日旁被誤認成日期。展開專案後「佔本專案」只標示一次不再每列重複，快取命中率說明也移至專屬小標題底下。⟦這有如整理多重幣別的計量儀表，將耗電長條全數照度數多寡排序，不同團隊採用一致中立色塊，讓讀表者一眼看清真實消耗。⟧
body.en: Reading model and project consumption rankings is now more consistent and intuitive. The Top 5 burn sessions used to be ranked by cost, while their bars — and every other "burn" in the report — measure tokens, so the second row could carry a longer bar than the first. Everything now ranks by tokens, with cost only breaking ties. Project bars now use one neutral colour instead of borrowing the tools' green, purple, and orange, so a project no longer looks like it belongs to Claude Code, Antigravity, or Codex; Grok's bar in the tools list is now the same pink as the chart instead of teal. Active days now reads "17 / 17 days" instead of looking like a date next to the peak-day card. "Share of project" is shown once per expanded project instead of on every model row, and the cache hit rate explanation now sits under its own heading. ⟦It's like tidying up a multi-currency meter panel: every burn bar gets sorted purely by its reading, different teams get the same neutral colour block, and the reader can tell real consumption at a glance.⟧

title.zh-TW: 手機版工作階段改為三行卡片，放大觸控按鈕並修正斷行排版
title.en: Top Sessions Become Three-Line Cards on Phones, Buttons Get Bigger and Line Breaks Get Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在手機螢幕上瀏覽用量明細時，窄版面的排版與觸控操作體驗更加順手。過去熱門工作階段常將 tokens 與花費擠出手機畫面外，現在改為三行卡片：首行列出專案、tokens 與花費，次行標註開始時間和時長，第三行顯示模型。寬度 780px 以下時，日期按鈕、輸入框、主題與分享鍵、Tokens 與花費切換及頁尾連結高度從原本 16 至 32px 提升到至少 44px，確保觸控容易點按。手機上日期與模型名稱不再從連字號處斷行，避免 `2026-05-` 與 `04` 拆成兩行。空白報表提示在五種語言補上 Antigravity 與 Grok（與 Claude Code 及 Codex 並列），頁尾 Ko-fi 連結減為一個，並重拍對齊新版面的報表截圖。⟦這彷彿將橫幅通訊錄重新剪裁為隨身便條，把重要資料分行排好，並將每顆按鈕放大到手指能從容點擊的友善間距。⟧
body.en: Browsing usage details on a phone screen is now easier to read and tap through. body.zh-TW: 搜尋或瀏覽 usage 官網時，多語系讀者能直接造訪專屬母語頁面。過去透過 `?lang=` 切換語言時，一律回傳英文 HTML 與英文 canonical（告知搜尋引擎代表性頁面的標準網址標記），導致其他四種語言無法被收錄。現在由 `scripts/build_site_pages.py` 從 `docs/index.html` 產生各語系獨立網頁（含 `/zh-TW/`、`/zh-CN/`、`/ja/`、`/ko/`），具備在地化標題、`html lang` 與專屬 canonical，CI 用 `--check` 把關。網站地圖與 hreflang 列出五語網址，舊 `?lang=` 連結仍可用。功能區改為附圖示卡片格，標題補上 Grok。⟦這如同觀光局為旅客印製專屬母語手冊與獨立展架，讓各語言讀者與搜尋引擎都能精準找到正確版本，不再全擠在英文櫃台前。⟧
body.en: Multilingual readers can now land directly on a page in their own language when they search or browse the usage website. Every `?lang=` URL used to serve the English HTML with an English canonical (the standard URL tag that tells search engines which page is authoritative), so the other four languages couldn't be indexed. `scripts/build_site_pages.py` now generates a standalone page per language (`/zh-TW/`, `/zh-CN/`, `/ja/`, `/ko/`) from `docs/index.html`, each with its own localized title, `html lang`, and canonical, checked by CI with `--check`. The sitemap and hreflang tags now list all five language URLs, and old `?lang=` links still work. The feature section is now a card grid with icons, and the headline includes Grok. ⟦It's like a tourism board printing a dedicated language brochure and display stand for each nationality of visitor, so readers and search engines alike can find the right version instead of everyone crowding the English-only counter.⟧

body.en: Reading through the usage website is now more polished in its accessibility and typographic details. The site picked up several fixes from Lighthouse, axe, and the Vercel Web Interface Guidelines: the mobile section menu now closes after a tap, and every scrollable region on the page is fully keyboard-reachable. Hero images now ship 800w and 1200w variants, cutting about 230KB off phone loads, and install commands are now marked `translate="no"`. On the typography side, headings now balance their length across lines and paragraphs avoid leaving a single word on the last line; Japanese and Korean headings no longer break mid-word, and inline commands no longer split at a hyphen. ⟦It's the kind of finish a print publication gets before binding: shrinking oversized images to lighten the load, tightening every line's spacing and word breaks, so flipping through it reads smoothly.⟧

entries: **The weekly quota warning no longer fires from a short burst of use, and the time it shows now matches the reason it fired** ([#138](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/138)). It used to extrapolate only the last 30–60 minutes of burn rate onto the 7-day window, so a dense working session alone could trigger a false alarm (e.g. 53.7% used, 3 days 1 hour to reset, warned "runs out in 13 hours"). `assess_weekly_quota()` now checks both rates: the short window still warns immediately if it alone predicts exhaustion within an hour, but otherwise the whole-week average must predict exhaustion at least 20% of the reset window early (`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`) before it warns — and displays that average's time instead of the short window's, which previously could show a number like "runs out in 8h55m" next to a warning actually driven by a slower week-long trend, contradicting the separate 5-hour session quota shown beside it. Session-quota warnings are unchanged.

**The Windows tray panel could stay stuck at `--` and Loading forever when `~/.claude/settings.json` had a UTF-8 BOM.** `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, and Python's JSON decoder rejects an otherwise-valid file that starts with a BOM with `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM`, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop ever completed. Both readers (`_load_settings()` and the legacy-usage migration) now open the file as `utf-8-sig`, which accepts the file with or without a BOM and does not change the parsed settings.

title.zh-TW: 週額度用完警示校準推算邏輯，短暫衝刺不再引發誤報
title.en: Weekly quota exhaustion warnings calibrate projection logic, preventing false alarms from brief usage bursts

body.zh-TW: 密集使用 AI 時，週額度用完警示不再因短時間衝刺就誤報。⟦這好比行車電腦預估剩餘續航，不能只因剛踩了幾秒重油門，就驚呼整桶油在半小時內見底。⟧過去只拿最近 30～60 分鐘的消耗速度外推整個 7 天週期，密集工作階段常引發假警報（例如本週用了 53.7%、還有 3 天 1 小時重置，卻警告「13 小時後用完」）。現在 `assess_weekly_quota()` 同時檢查兩種速度：短窗速度若預測 1 小時內用完仍會立刻示警；其餘情況須整週平均速度預測用完時間提前至少 20%（`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`）才警示。介面改為顯示整週平均預測的時間，不再出現「8h55m 後用完」卻與旁邊 5 小時工作階段額度矛盾的狀況；5 小時工作階段額度警示規則維持不變。
body.en: During intensive AI use, weekly quota exhaustion warnings no longer trigger false alarms from short bursts of activity. ⟦This is like a trip computer estimating remaining range—it shouldn't panic that the entire tank will run dry in half an hour just because you stepped on the gas for a few seconds.⟧ Previously, it extrapolated only the burn rate from the last 30–60 minutes across the entire 7-day cycle, so intensive sessions often triggered false alarms (such as using 53.7% this week with 3 days and 1 hour until reset, yet warning "runs out in 13 hours"). Now, `assess_weekly_quota()` checks both rates: if the short-window rate predicts exhaustion within 1 hour, it still warns immediately; otherwise, the whole-week average rate must predict exhaustion at least 20% early (`WEEKLY_AVERAGE_WARNING_RATIO`) before raising a warning. The interface now displays the time predicted by the whole-week average, eliminating confusing scenarios where "runs out in 8h55m" contradicted the adjacent 5-hour session quota; rules for 5-hour session quota warnings remain unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣支援 UTF-8 BOM 設定檔，徹底告別卡死與載入中
title.en: Windows system tray supports UTF-8 BOM config files, resolving freezes and endless loading

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 電腦上，當 Claude 設定檔 `~/.claude/settings.json` 帶有 UTF-8 BOM（位元組順序記號，部分編輯器在開頭加入的隱藏標記），系統匣面板不再卡在 `--` 與 Loading。過去 `installer/setup_hook.py` 用一般 `utf-8` 開啟檔案，Python 的解析器把開頭帶 BOM 的有效檔案判為 `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM` 錯誤，導致啟動自我修復步驟在刷新迴圈跑完前就失敗。現在 `_load_settings()` 與舊版遷移邏輯皆改用 `utf-8-sig`，不論檔案有無 BOM 都能正常讀取且設定內容不變。⟦這宛如收發窗口先前看到信件開頭多了一枚印章，就誤判整份合規公文無效而拒絕拆閱；換上相容的判讀方式後，運作才重回正軌。⟧
body.en: On Windows, when Claude's config file `~/.claude/settings.json` contains a UTF-8 BOM (byte order mark, a hidden marker added at the beginning by some editors), the system tray panel no longer gets stuck at `--` and Loading. Previously, `installer/setup_hook.py` opened the file as plain `utf-8`, causing Python's parser to reject valid files with a BOM with an `Unexpected UTF-8 BOM` error, so the startup self-heal step failed before the refresh loop could complete. Now, both `_load_settings()` and the legacy migration logic use `utf-8-sig`, reading the file properly whether a BOM is present or not without altering parsed settings. ⟦This is like a mailroom rejecting a valid official document simply because it has an extra stamp at the top; switching to a compatible reading method puts operations back on track.⟧

Both readers (`_load_settings()` and the legacy-usage migration) now open the file as `utf-8-sig`, which accepts the file with or without a BOM and does not change the parsed settings.

entries: **The report's date range can be changed inside the page** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)). The HTML report used to freeze its period at generation time, so a copy sent to someone else could not be explored. A day × tool × model × project table (about 80 KB) is now embedded, and every date-dependent section recalculates in the browser from five shortcuts or a custom from/to range in a sticky bar. No app and no regeneration are needed, so a shared file stays fully usable. Sections that always cover a fixed span say so, so they don't look broken when the dates change.

**Report history survives transcript cleanup.** The report recomputed everything from `~/.claude/projects` and `~/.codex/sessions`, which grow by roughly 1.9 GB a month, so deleting old transcripts erased report history with them. Totals are now kept in `~/.usage/usage_snapshot.json` at (session, date, tool, model, project) grain, plus each session's start time and duration so the session ranking survives too. When a day's live transcripts hold fewer tokens than the snapshot, that day is replayed from the snapshot; stored costs are used as-is rather than repriced against today's price list. On real data, reports for today / week / last 7 days / month / all were byte-identical except for the generation time with transcripts present and with all of them simulated as deleted.
**Daily usage chart.** A stacked bar per day, coloured by tool, with a Tokens/Cost toggle, a hover breakdown, and redraws when the date range changes.

**Cost confidence.** Shows how much usage has a public price and how much does not, names the unpriced models, and states plainly that cost is the API-equivalent value from public price lists, not a subscription bill.

**The report is reorganised around what people read first.** Order is now summary cards → usage trend → your tools → projects → costliest sessions → the fixed-span group (heatmap, habits, recent work, insights) → how these numbers are calculated → Year in Review. The main-model section repeated the tools section's numbers exactly, so it is gone; each tool row now expands to show its models, and expanded rows stay open when the date range changes. The project donut repeated the ranking below it and was removed. "Weekly burn trend" is now "Usage trend". Token mix, cache hit rate and cost confidence live in a collapsed "How these numbers are calculated" card. The five "fixed range" tags became one note above the group they apply to.

**Visual pass across the report.** Filled bars behind ranking, tool, composition and weekly rows became 2px tracks along the bottom edge; only token figures stay yellow. Summary cards are separate rounded boxes that lead with the abbreviated number and show the exact count underneath. Section spacing and title sizes are consistent, every section shares one left and right edge, and expandable rows highlight on hover. On phones, a project is one line instead of four, a tool is two lines instead of four, the session table scrolls sideways instead of wrapping, and the heatmap keeps readable cells and opens scrolled to the latest weeks.
**The summary sentence no longer states a project count.** Projects are attributed by working folder, so non-git folders and replayed history still inflate the number enough to mislead.
**Grok is pink in the report.** Its previous green sat next to Claude's green in the stacked daily chart and the two could not be told apart.

**Claude sessions opened in a repo subfolder no longer count as separate projects.** `adapters/claude.py` used only the last folder name, so `tests/`, `docs/` and `panels/` each became a project. It now uses the same `resolve_project_name()` git lookup as Codex, Grok and Antigravity, and the shared cache grew from 256 to 2048 entries so several tools' folders together don't push it into repeated `git` calls. Days that can only be replayed from the snapshot keep the folder names recorded at the time.
**Previous-period comparisons no longer reach before the first day of data** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)), which produced growth like `↑2799%`.
**A tool group with one unpriced model no longer hides its whole cost** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); Antigravity's $166 had been shown as `—`.

**Collapsed rows actually collapse** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)). `.rank-line`'s `display:grid` outranked the browser's `[hidden]`, so collapsing changed the DOM but not the screen.
**Session ranking bars no longer pile up in the top-left corner** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); `.tokens-cell` was missing `position:relative`.

**Expanded model rows are no longer wider than their parent.** Child bars were drawn as share-of-project on the same scale as the parent's share-of-total, so a model at 68.7% of a project looked three times bigger than the project itself.

title.zh-TW: 報表依閱讀動線重新排版，視覺降噪並最佳化手機瀏覽
title.en: Report layout reorganized around reading flow, reducing visual noise and optimizing mobile viewing

body.zh-TW: 用量報表打開後，版面按閱讀順序重排。⟦像把年報改成目錄，先放總覽，撤掉重複圖表，細節收進可展開頁籤，手機也不迷路。⟧順序是摘要卡、用量趨勢、工具、專案、高花費工作階段、固定週期群組、計算方式、年度回顧。主力模型區塊因重複工具數字而移除；工具列可展開模型，切換日期後保持展開；專案甜甜圈圖因重複排行而刪除。每週燃燒趨勢改名為「用量趨勢」。token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）組成、快取命中率與花費可信度收進折疊的計算卡，五個 fixed range 標籤變成群組上方說明。色條改成底緣 2px 細線，只有 token 數字維持黃色；摘要卡獨立成圓角框，先顯示縮寫數字，下方列精確數字。區塊間距、標題大小與左右邊界也統一，可展開列滑過會高亮。手機上專案一行、工具兩行，工作階段表格橫滑，熱圖保留可讀格子並自動捲到最新週數。開頭摘要移除專案數，因非 git 資料夾與重播歷史會墊高數字。
body.en: When opening the usage report, the layout is now rearranged in reading order. ⟦It is like turning an annual report into a table of contents: leading with the overview, stripping redundant charts, tucking details into expandable tabs, and keeping mobile navigation effortless.⟧ The sequence is now summary cards, usage trend, tools, projects, costliest sessions, fixed-span group, calculation details, and Year in Review. The main model section was removed because it duplicated tool numbers; tool rows can expand to reveal models and remain open after switching dates; the project donut chart was removed for repeating ranking data. "Weekly burn trend" is renamed to "Usage trend". Token composition, cache hit rate, and cost confidence are tucked into a collapsed calculation card, while five "fixed range" tags became a single note above their group. Colored bars were replaced with 2px lines along the bottom edge, with only token figures keeping their yellow color. Summary cards are separate rounded boxes that display abbreviated numbers first, followed by exact figures underneath. Section spacing, heading sizes, and horizontal margins are unified, with expandable rows highlighting on hover. On mobile, projects take one line and tools take two lines, session tables scroll horizontally, and the heatmap retains readable grid cells while automatically scrolling to the latest weeks. The opening summary removes the project count, as non-git folders and replayed history inflate the figure.

items.original:
**The report is reorganised around what people read first.** Order is now summary cards → usage trend → your tools → projects → costliest sessions → the fixed-span group (heatmap, habits, recent work, insights) → how these numbers are calculated → Year in Review. The main-model section repeated the tools section's numbers exactly, so it is gone; each tool row now expands to show its models, and expanded rows stay open when the date range changes. The project donut repeated the ranking below it and was removed. "Weekly burn trend" is now "Usage trend". Token mix, cache hit rate and cost confidence live in a collapsed "How these numbers are calculated" card. The five "fixed range" tags became one note above the group they apply to.
**Visual pass across the report.** Filled bars behind ranking, tool, composition and weekly rows became 2px tracks along the bottom edge; only token figures stay yellow. Summary cards are separate rounded boxes that lead with the abbreviated number and show the exact count underneath. Section spacing and title sizes are consistent, every section shares one left and right edge, and expandable rows highlight on hover. On phones, a project is one line instead of four, a tool is two lines instead of four, the session table scrolls sideways instead of wrapping, and the heatmap keeps readable cells and opens scrolled to the latest weeks.
**The summary sentence no longer states a project count.** Projects are attributed by working folder, so non-git folders and replayed history still inflate the number enough to mislead.

title.zh-TW: 新增每日用量堆疊圖與花費可信度，工具分色不再混淆
title.en: New daily stacked usage chart and cost confidence, with distinct tool colors eliminating confusion

body.zh-TW: 想看清各家 AI 每天的花費與用量節奏，報表新增了直觀的每日用量圖表。圖表每天顯示一根堆疊長條並依工具分色，右上角提供 Tokens 與花費切換開關，滑鼠懸停即可檢視當日用量細項，切換日期時也會跟著重新繪製。為了讓各家工具一目了然，Grok 的代表色改為粉紅色，徹底解決過往綠色與相鄰 Claude 綠色混在一起難以分辨的困擾。此外，報表增設「花費可信度」標記，明確列出有多少比例的用量具備公開價格、多少沒有，並直接點名缺乏公開報價的模型。介面也明白告知讀者，統計顯示的金額是依公開價目表折算的 API 等值花費，並非你的訂閱制月租帳單。⟦這種透明度恰如商務飯店出具的明細單，每天的消費以不同顏色長條清楚區分，附上幣別切換與項目透視，並誠實註記未定價項目的等值折算依據。⟧
body.en: To provide clear visibility into daily spending and usage pacing across different AIs, the report adds an intuitive daily usage chart. The chart displays a stacked bar per day colored by tool, featuring a Tokens/Cost toggle in the top-right corner and hover tooltips for daily breakdowns, automatically redrawing when the date range changes. To make each tool instantly recognizable, Grok's color is changed to pink, resolving the issue where its previous green blended into the adjacent Claude green. In addition, the report introduces a "Cost confidence" badge that specifies the exact proportion of usage backed by public pricing versus unpriced usage, explicitly naming models without public rates. The interface also clearly informs readers that reported costs represent API-equivalent values calculated from public price lists rather than subscription bills. ⟦This transparency is like an itemized hotel invoice where each day's expenses are distinguished by colored bars, complete with currency toggles, line-item breakdowns, and clear explanations for estimated unpriced services.⟧

items.original:
**Daily usage chart.** A stacked bar per day, coloured by tool, with a Tokens/Cost toggle, a hover breakdown, and redraws when the date range changes.
**Cost confidence.** Shows how much usage has a public price and how much does not, names the unpriced models, and states plainly that cost is the API-equivalent value from public price lists, not a subscription bill.
**Grok is pink in the report.** Its previous green sat next to Claude's green in the stacked daily chart and the two could not be told apart.

title.zh-TW: Claude 子目錄工作階段依 Git 歸屬專案，快取擴大防止重複查詢
title.en: Claude sessions in subdirectories attributed to parent repo via Git, with expanded cache preventing repeated lookups

body.zh-TW: 在專案子資料夾啟動 Claude，用量現在會正確歸入同一個母專案。過去 `adapters/claude.py` 處理工作階段（session）只取路徑最後一層名稱，導致 `tests/`、`docs/` 或 `panels/` 都被誤算成獨立專案。新版改用與 Codex、Grok 及 Antigravity 相同的 `resolve_project_name()` 判斷 git 根目錄。為了避免多個工具的資料夾加總後反覆呼叫 `git`，共用快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）上限從 256 筆調升至 2048 筆。只能從小計快照還原的舊日期，則沿用當時記下的資料夾名稱。⟦這彷彿收發室先前只看包裹的辦公室門牌，把同一部門信件拆給不同客戶；改查大樓總地址後，信件才正確歸入同案。⟧
body.en: Launching Claude inside a project subfolder now correctly attributes usage to the same parent project. Previously, `adapters/claude.py` handled sessions by taking only the last folder name in the path, causing `tests/`, `docs/`, or `panels/` to be miscounted as standalone projects. The new version switches to `resolve_project_name()`, matching Codex, Grok, and Antigravity to determine the git root. To avoid repeated `git` calls when aggregating folders across multiple tools, the shared cache limit was raised from 256 to 2048 entries. Older dates that can only be replayed from subtotal snapshots retain the folder names recorded at that time. ⟦It is as if a mailroom previously looked only at office door numbers on packages, sorting letters for the same department into different client bins; checking the building's main address finally routes every mail item to the correct project.⟧

items.original: **Claude sessions opened in a repo subfolder no longer count as separate projects.** `adapters/claude.py` used only the last folder name, so `tests/`, `docs/` and `panels/` each became a project. It now uses the same `resolve_project_name()` git lookup as Codex, Grok and Antigravity, and the shared cache grew from 256 to 2048 entries so several tools' folders together don't push it into repeated `git` calls. Days that can only be replayed from the snapshot keep the folder names recorded at the time.

title.zh-TW: 報表修復排版與圖表比例，校準前期統計與混合計價
title.en: Report fixes layout and chart proportions, calibrating prior-period comparisons and mixed pricing

body.zh-TW: 瀏覽 HTML 報表時，多項版面與統計問題已修正。前期比較不再算到資料起始日之前，排除了如 `↑2799%` 的假成長；工具分組混到未定價模型也不再把整組花費隱藏成 `—`，Antigravity 曾被藏起的 $166 現已正常顯示。因 `.rank-line` 的 `display:grid` 權重高於瀏覽器 `[hidden]` 導致收合失效的問題已排除，收合列會確實收起；`.tokens-cell` 補上 `position:relative`，工作階段（session）排行的長條不再全疊在頁面左上角；展開的模型子列修正尺規，不再把專案佔比套用總量尺度，避免佔專案 68.7% 的模型看起來比專案本身大三倍。⟦這好比校對帳冊排版，校正前後期基準日，把摺疊欄位確實藏起並歸位重疊圖條，不再讓細項畫得比總額還長。⟧
body.en: Several layout and statistical issues in the HTML report have been resolved. Previous-period comparisons no longer reach before the first day of data, eliminating artificial growth spikes such as `↑2799%`. Tool groups mixed with unpriced models no longer hide their entire cost as `—`, properly displaying Antigravity's previously hidden $166. An issue where `.rank-line`'s `display:grid` overrode the browser's `[hidden]` attribute has been fixed, ensuring collapsed rows actually collapse. Adding `position:relative` to `.tokens-cell` prevents session ranking bars from piling up in the top-left corner. Expanded model sub-rows now use corrected scaling rather than plotting project share on the total-volume scale, preventing a model accounting for 68.7% of a project from looking three times larger than the project itself. ⟦This is like proofing a ledger's layout: calibrating baseline comparison dates, properly hiding collapsed rows, repositioning overlapping bars, and preventing sub-items from being drawn longer than the total.⟧

items.original:
**Previous-period comparisons no longer reach before the first day of data** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)), which produced growth like `↑2799%`.
**A tool group with one unpriced model no longer hides its whole cost** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); Antigravity's $166 had been shown as `—`.
**Collapsed rows actually collapse** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)). `.rank-line`'s `display:grid` outranked the browser's `[hidden]`, so collapsing changed the DOM but not the screen.
**Session ranking bars no longer pile up in the top-left corner** ([#137](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/pull/137)); `.tokens-cell` was missing `position:relative`.
**Expanded model rows are no longer wider than their parent.** Child bars were drawn as share-of-project on the same scale as the parent's share-of-total, so a model at 68.7% of a project looked three times bigger than the project itself.

entries: **No more black console windows flashing at Windows startup** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). `usage.exe` is packaged without a console, but no `subprocess` call in the project passed `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`, so Windows created and closed a console window for every child process. The flash count equalled the number of distinct project directories in the Claude history — `resolve_project_name()` runs `git worktree list --porcelain` once per directory and caches per process, so every launch repeated it. A shared `usage_common/subprocess_utils.py` now supplies the `creationflags`, every child process in the project goes through it, and the missing `stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL` was added along the way. `usage_session_resume.py` and `usage_statusline_forwarder.py` are copied verbatim into `~/.claude/` and run by the system Python, so they keep an inlined equivalent instead of importing the project; a new test uses `ast` to keep every copied-out script free of project imports. The forwarder also had no version-upgrade path at all — `_copy_forwarder_script()` was only called on reinstall or when the state looked broken — so it gained `FORWARDER_VERSION` and a `self_heal()` upgrade step like the other hooks.

**The Windows panel no longer flashes at its old position before moving.** pywebview's WinForms backend passes `SWP_SHOWWINDOW` in both `resize()` and `move()`, so the `resize()` in `_place_window_on_ui_thread()` made the still-hidden window visible at the previous coordinates; the following `move()` then moved it and only then did `show()` run. Measured at 1 ms sampling, the window sat visible in the wrong place for 36 ms, about two frames. Position and size are now applied while the window is hidden in a single `SetWindowPos` without `SWP_SHOWWINDOW`, leaving display to the existing `show()` path; without a native handle, or off Windows, it falls back to `resize()` + `move()` unchanged. Applying geometry is also skipped entirely when the current physical-pixel geometry already matches, so `_apply_content_height_now()` no longer makes a pointless native call when the content height has not changed.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板不再先閃現舊位置，單次設定尺寸坐標徹底消除跳動
title.en: Windows panel no longer flashes at old position, single geometry update eliminates jumpiness

body.zh-TW: 點開 Windows 面板時，畫面不再先在舊坐標閃爍一下才跳回定位。pywebview 的 WinForms 後端在 resize() 與 move() 都帶 SWP_SHOWWINDOW，使 _place_window_on_ui_thread() 提早在舊坐標顯示視窗，隨後才移到定點。以 1 毫秒取樣實測，面板在錯位可見 36 毫秒，約兩個畫面幀。現在視窗改在隱藏時以單次 SetWindowPos 一起設定位置與大小且不帶顯示旗標，顯示交由 show() 處理；非 Windows 或取不到原生視窗時退回既有備援流程。套用前也會先比對目前的實體像素幾何，完全相同便跳過，避免 _apply_content_height_now() 在高度未變時白白呼叫。⟦這種穿幫宛如舞台劇換幕，道具桌還留在上一場的站位，工作人員就失手拉開布幕才急忙把它推定位。⟧
body.en: When opening the Windows panel, the screen no longer flashes briefly at its old coordinates before snapping into position. The WinForms backend of pywebview passed SWP_SHOWWINDOW in both resize() and move(), causing _place_window_on_ui_thread() to prematurely display the window at previous coordinates before moving it to its target location. Measured at 1 ms sampling, the panel was visible in the wrong position for 36 ms, or about two frames. The window now sets position and size together via a single SetWindowPos without show flags while hidden, leaving display to show(), and falls back to the existing fallback flow off Windows or when native handles are unavailable. It also compares the current physical-pixel geometry before applying and skips entirely if identical, preventing _apply_content_height_now() from being called unnecessarily when height is unchanged. ⟦This glitch is like a stage scene change where the prop table is still at the previous scene's spot when staff accidentally pull open the curtain before hastily shoving it into place.⟧

Measured at 1 ms sampling, the window sat visible in the wrong place for 36 ms, about two frames. Position and size are now applied while the window is hidden in a single `SetWindowPos` without `SWP_SHOWWINDOW`, leaving display to the existing `show()` path; without a native handle, or off Windows, it falls back to `resize()` + `move()` unchanged. entries: **The Windows panel opens inside the screen at high display scaling** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). pywebview 6.2.1 returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them as scale 1.0, while `move()` / `resize()` multiply their input by the window's DPI again. At 250% on 3840x2160 the default x came out as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved, so every relaunch repeated it. Screen rectangles are now converted to logical pixels with the window's own DPI (only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, so a future pywebview that fixes this is not double-converted), and `window.show()` is queued behind the placement so the panel never appears at a stale position.

**The Windows panel reopens on the display it was closed on with mixed scaling.** The saved position was physical pixels divided by the DPI of whichever monitor the window was on at that moment, so a panel closed on a 225% display reopened on the 100% primary. Positions are now saved in physical pixels and converted with the window's current DPI when placed. The preference key and shape are unchanged.

**The bottom of the Windows panel is no longer cut off on short high-DPI screens.** The 0.6 zoom floor did not account for the window's DPI, so at 2560x1440 @225% the panel was held above the zoom it needed and lost its rate/status row and Refresh/Quit buttons. Windows now uses `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale` as the floor, so text still never renders smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display; macOS is unchanged.

**The Windows tray tooltip is capped at 127 characters.** Since the Grok row was added, the English tooltip with every provider at 100% reached 129 characters; pystray raised `ValueError: string too long`, which `_refresh_worker()` swallowed along with the same iteration's `inject_state()`, so an open panel silently stopped updating.

**Installed status line and session resume hooks are replaced with the current copies.** Both scripts had changed without a version bump — the status line's `1000k` fix and ten session-resume fixes since July — so existing installs kept the old files. The status line goes to `1.6` and session resume to `1.7`, and a new test keeps the session-resume script version and installer constant in step.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板在高縮放螢幕不再貼邊，重開位置精準
title.en: Windows panel no longer clings to screen edge at high scaling, reopening accurately

body.zh-TW: 使用 3840x2160 高解析度螢幕並開啟 250% 縮放時，Windows 面板現在會準確開在畫面之內。⟦這好比木工師傅照著設計圖施工，助手卻誤把圖面上的公尺當成公分再放大換算，讓做好的櫃子直接卡死在牆角。⟧底層套件 `pywebview 6.2.1` 回傳的螢幕範圍明明是實體像素，卻標記成縮放 1.0。後續 `move()` 與 `resize()` 又拿視窗自身 DPI 重複相乘，使得預設水平坐標被算成 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448，將面板釘在右下角邊緣，且該位置還被存檔讓每次重開都重演。現在程式只在主螢幕回報 1.0 且視窗 DPI 不是 96 時，才用視窗自己的 DPI 將螢幕矩形換算回邏輯像素，避免未來 `pywebview` 修好時重複換算；同時將 `window.show()` 排在擺位之後，面板絕不再閃現在舊位置。
body.en: When using a 3840x2160 high-resolution display with 250% scaling, the Windows panel now opens accurately within the screen bounds. ⟦This is like a carpenter building according to blueprints, but an assistant mistakes meters for centimeters and scales them up again, leaving the finished cabinet wedged tightly against the wall corner.⟧ The underlying package `pywebview 6.2.1` returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them with a scale of 1.0. Subsequent `move()` and `resize()` operations then multiplied their inputs by the window's own DPI again, causing the default horizontal coordinate to be calculated as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved so every relaunch repeated the issue. Now the program converts screen rectangles back to logical pixels using the window's own DPI only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, preventing double conversion if a future `pywebview` release fixes this; at the same time, `window.show()` is queued after placement, ensuring the panel never flashes at a stale position.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板支援混合縮放多螢幕，重開精準回到原螢幕
title.en: Windows panel supports mixed-scaling multi-monitor setups, reopening precisely on the original display

body.zh-TW: 外接不同螢幕工作的讀者，若各螢幕設定了不同的縮放比例，關閉 Windows 面板後重新開啟，它現在會老實回到當初關閉的那台螢幕。先前系統儲存面板位置時，是把實體像素除以視窗當下所在螢幕的 DPI；這導致在 225% 縮放螢幕上關閉的面板，重新開啟時卻莫名其妙彈回 100% 的主螢幕。新版改為直接儲存實體像素，等到擺放面板位置時，才搭配視窗當下的 DPI 進行換算。⟦這如同在不同比例尺的地圖之間穿梭，標記位置時若除以當前圖紙比例，重新翻開時便會走樣跳回起點；改存真實公尺距離後，在哪張地圖合上就在哪張地圖展開。⟧這項改進完全不改變偏好設定的鍵名與資料格式。
body.en: For users working with external monitors configured with different scale factors, closing the Windows panel and reopening it now reliably returns it to the specific display where it was closed. Previously, the system saved the panel's position by dividing physical pixels by the DPI of whichever display the window was currently on; as a result, a panel closed on a 225% scaling display would unexpectedly jump back to the 100% primary screen upon reopening. The new version saves positions directly in physical pixels and only converts them using the window's current DPI when placing the panel. ⟦This is like navigating between maps of different scales: if marked locations are divided by the current sheet's ratio, reopening them distorts the coordinates back to the starting point; storing the actual meter distances instead ensures that whichever map you close on is where you reopen.⟧ This improvement leaves preference key names and data formats completely unchanged.

items.original: **The Windows panel reopens on the display it was closed on with mixed scaling.** The saved position was physical pixels divided by the DPI of whichever monitor the window was on at that moment, so a panel closed on a 225% display reopened on the 100% primary. Positions are now saved in physical pixels and converted with the window's current DPI when placed. The preference key and shape are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板放寬矮螢幕縮放下限，按鈕與狀態列不再裁切
title.en: Windows panel relaxes zoom floor on short displays, preventing buttons and status row from being cut off

body.zh-TW: 把 Windows 面板開在偏矮的螢幕上時，若曾碰過重新整理或結束按鈕被切出畫面外的窘境，現在這類版面裁切問題已徹底解決。⟦這彷彿在低矮的天花板下擺放展示架，若硬性規定層架間隔不能縮小，最底層的控制旋鈕就會被地面擋住；按空間比例動態調降底線，底部按鍵才不被擠出視野。⟧過去面板設有 0.6 的縮放下限，卻未考慮視窗自身的 DPI，使得 2560x1440 搭配 225% 縮放時，面板被卡在比實際需要更大的縮放比例，導致速率與狀態列以及重新整理和結束按鈕全部掉出畫面之外。現在 Windows 將縮放下限改為 `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale`，確保文字顯示依然絕不小於 100% 螢幕的 0.6 倍，同時讓整張面板順利塞進螢幕內；macOS 則維持原樣不變。
body.en: When opening the Windows panel on shorter screens, any issues where the Refresh or Quit buttons were cut off outside the viewport are now completely resolved. ⟦This is like placing a display rack under a low ceiling: if shelf spacing is rigidly forbidden from shrinking, the bottom control knobs get blocked by the floor; dynamically lowering the floor based on available space keeps bottom buttons from being squeezed out of view.⟧ Previously, the panel enforced a 0.6 zoom floor without accounting for the window's own DPI, causing the panel at 2560x1440 with 225% scaling to remain stuck above the zoom level it actually needed, which pushed the rate and status row as well as the Refresh and Quit buttons entirely off-screen. Windows now changes the zoom floor to `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale`, ensuring text rendering is still never smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display while allowing the entire panel to fit smoothly inside the screen; macOS remains unchanged.

items.original: **The bottom of the Windows panel is no longer cut off on short high-DPI screens.** The 0.6 zoom floor did not account for the window's DPI, so at 2560x1440 @225% the panel was held above the zoom it needed and lost its rate/status row and Refresh/Quit buttons. Windows now uses `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale` as the floor, so text still never renders smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display; macOS is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣提示限制字數，避免例外吞沒導致面板停更
title.en: Windows tray tooltip enforces character limit, preventing swallowed exceptions from stalling panel updates

body.zh-TW: 開啟 Windows 系統匣觀察各家 AI 用量，開著的面板現在絕不會無聲無息地停止更新。先前新增了 Grok 欄位之後，在英文介面且每家提供商額度皆滿 100% 的極端狀況下，提示文字長度會達到 129 個字元；這讓底層圖示套件 `pystray` 拋出 `ValueError: string too long` 錯誤，但該錯誤卻被背景工作常駐程式 `_refresh_worker()` 默默吞掉，連同該輪更新畫面的 `inject_state()` 也一併跳過，導致面板看似開著卻再也不會刷新數據。現在系統匣提示文字強制限制在 127 個字元以內，徹底防範字串過長引發的崩潰。⟦這種脫節宛如展場跑馬燈因文字過長當機，值班警衛不但沒回報還順手切斷訊號線，讓大廳螢幕默默停在上一輪舊畫面。⟧
body.en: When opening the Windows tray to check AI usage across providers, an open panel will no longer silently stop updating. Previously, after adding the Grok row, tooltip text reached 129 characters in the extreme case of an English interface with every provider's quota at 100%; this caused the underlying icon library `pystray` to raise a `ValueError: string too long` error, which was silently swallowed by the background worker `_refresh_worker()`, skipping that cycle's UI update `inject_state()` as well and leaving the open panel unable to refresh data. The tray tooltip text is now strictly capped at 127 characters, completely preventing crashes caused by excessively long strings. ⟦This disconnection is like an exhibition marquee crashing from text that is too long, and instead of reporting it, the duty guard casually disconnects the signal cable, leaving the lobby display quietly frozen on the previous frame.⟧

items.original: **The Windows tray tooltip is capped at 127 characters.** Since the Grok row was added, the English tooltip with every provider at 100% reached 129 characters; pystray raised `ValueError: string too long`, which `_refresh_worker()` swallowed along with the same iteration's `inject_state()`, so an open panel silently stopped updating.

title.zh-TW: 終端機狀態列與接續提醒自動換新，補齊修復並校準版號
title.en: Terminal status line and session resume hooks update automatically, incorporating fixes and aligning version numbers

body.zh-TW: 先前已在電腦中安裝過狀態列與工作階段接續提醒的使用者，現在升級時會自動替換成最新版腳本。過去這兩支 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）雖然歷經多次修改，涵蓋狀態列進位的 `1000k` 修正以及 7 月以來工作階段接續提醒的十項修正，卻因為未調升版號，讓既有安裝一直留在舊檔案。新版將狀態列升級至 1.6 版、接續提醒升級至 1.7 版，安裝程式會主動用最新副本覆蓋舊檔，並新增自動化測試確保腳本版號與安裝常數隨時步調一致。⟦這恰似圖書館借閱處更新了服務規章，封皮上的版本代號卻漏未換新，讓館員誤以為抽屜裡積滿灰塵的舊手冊仍是現行規定。⟧
body.en: Users who previously installed the status line and session resume hooks on their systems will now have them automatically replaced with the latest script versions upon upgrading. In the past, although both hooks underwent numerous modifications—including the status line rounding fix for `1000k` and ten fixes to session resume since July—the lack of version bumps left existing installations stuck on older files. The new release bumps the status line to version 1.6 and session resume to 1.7, with the installer actively overwriting old files with the latest copies and adding an automated test to ensure script version numbers and installer constants stay strictly in step. ⟦This is just like a library circulation desk updating its service policies but forgetting to update the version code on the cover, leading librarians to mistakenly believe the dusty manual in the drawer is still the active rulebook.⟧

items.original: **Installed status line and session resume hooks are replaced with the current copies.** Both scripts had changed without a version bump — the status line's `1000k` fix and ten session-resume fixes since July — so existing installs kept the old files. The status line goes to `1.6` and session resume to `1.7`, and a new test keeps the session-resume script version and installer constant in step.

entries: **`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is respected everywhere, not only for transcripts** ([#129](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/129)). With a relocated Claude Code config dir, "Set Up Status Line" wrote to `~/.claude/settings.json`, which Claude Code never read, so both quota bars sat at 0% with "Reset imminent", the fallback surfaced a stale `~/.claude.json`, and Project Usage stayed empty because an `.app` launched from Finder or the Dock does not inherit the shell environment. A new `loaders/claude_paths.py` resolves the directory from the environment, then `launchctl getenv CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, then `~/.claude`; comma-separated values are read in full and written to the first entry. Files Claude Code owns follow it — `settings.json`, `.claude.json` (inside the directory whenever the variable is set, the same rule Claude Code uses), and `projects/`. usage's own files — the statusline script, `usage-status.json`, prefs — stay pinned to `~/.claude`: the script runs as a Claude Code subprocess and sees the variable while the app may not, and deriving both from it would let them write and read in different places.

**Token counts no longer read `1000k` at a unit boundary.** The three statusline scripts promoted to `M` at `value >= 1_000_000`, but `k` is formatted `:.0f`, so anything from 999,500 rounded to `1000k` first; there was no `B` step either, so 1.5 billion read `1500.0M`. The thresholds now compare against the rounded boundary (999,500 for k→M, 999,950,000 for M→B) and a `B` step was added, matching the already-correct version in `ui/tables.py`.

**Weekly trend bars in the report show their date range and cost on hover.** Each row only carried a token count, with no way to tell which week it was or what it cost. The range is clamped to the report's actual span, so an unfinished last week does not claim seven days next to three days of numbers.
**Insight notes in the report are square, borderless tinted rows.** They were the last framed surface left — 8px corners and a 3px left stripe — and now match the report's other full-row fills.

title.zh-TW: 自訂 Claude Code 設定路徑處處生效，狀態列與專案用量不再空白
title.en: Custom Claude Code config paths take effect everywhere, keeping status lines and project usage from going blank

body.zh-TW:
如果你搬移了 Claude Code 的設定資料夾，狀態列與專案用量現在處處都能正常讀取。⟦這好比工作室搬遷後，公文仍投進舊信箱，讓新辦公室的值班看板始終查無進度。⟧先前「設定狀態列」仍寫進 `~/.claude/settings.json`，Claude Code 根本不讀，兩條額度長條圖停在 0% 且標記「即將重置」；備援機制甚至翻出過期的 `~/.claude.json`，且從 Finder 或 Dock 開啟的桌面程式抓不到終端機變數，專案用量一片空白。

```
# 路徑解析順序（逗號分隔時讀取全部、寫入第一筆）：
# 1. 環境變數 CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
# 2. launchctl getenv CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
# 3. 預設路徑 ~/.claude

# 跟隨變數搬移：settings.json, .claude.json, projects/
# 固定留在原處：狀態列腳本, usage-status.json, 偏好設定
```

新版 `loaders/claude_paths.py` 依序解析目錄，Claude Code 檔案跟著走，而 usage 自己的檔案固定留在原處，避免子行程與桌面端分頭讀寫造成錯位。
body.en:
If you relocate Claude Code's configuration directory, the status line and project usage can now be read properly everywhere. ⟦It is like moving to a new studio while official mail is still delivered to the old mailbox, leaving the duty board in the new office with no updates to display.⟧ Previously, "Set Up Status Line" still wrote to `~/.claude/settings.json`, which Claude Code never read, leaving both quota bars stuck at 0% with "Reset imminent"; the fallback mechanism even surfaced a stale `~/.claude.json`, and desktop apps launched from Finder or the Dock could not catch terminal environment variables, leaving project usage completely blank.

```
# Path resolution order (reads all when comma-separated, writes to the first entry):
# 1. Environment variable CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
# 2. launchctl getenv CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
# 3. Default path ~/.claude

# Moves with the variable: settings.json, .claude.json, projects/
# Stays pinned in place: statusline script, usage-status.json, preferences
```

The new `loaders/claude_paths.py` resolves directories in order so that Claude Code files follow the variable while usage's own files stay pinned in place, preventing misalignment from subprocesses and the desktop app reading and writing in different locations.
