Files Claude Code owns follow it — `settings.json`, `.claude.json` (inside the directory whenever the variable is set, the same rule Claude Code uses), and `projects/`. usage's own files — the statusline script, `usage-status.json`, prefs — stay pinned to `~/.claude`: the script runs as a Claude Code subprocess and sees the variable while the app may not, and deriving both from it would let them write and read in different places.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列 Token 在單位邊界不再顯示 1000k，並補齊十億級距
title.en: Status line token counts no longer show 1000k at unit boundaries, adding the billion step

body.zh-TW: 在狀態列查看消耗進度時，若 Token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數值剛好逼近單位邊界，現在不再顯示彆扭的 `1000k`。⟦這種尷尬宛如汽車儀表板的里程計數器，在行駛累積到九百九十九點五公尺時本該跳轉為一公里，卻因提早進位而顯示出一千公尺；重新對準門檻後，大單位才會準時接棒切換。⟧過去三支狀態列腳本在數值達到 1,000,000 時才升級為 `M`，但 `k` 是整數格式化，999,500 以上會先四捨五入成 `1000k`；腳本也沒有 `B` 級距，使得 15 億被印成 `1500.0M`。現在門檻改為比對進位後的邊界（`k` 到 `M` 用 999,500、`M` 到 `B` 用 999,950,000）並補上 `B` 級距，對齊 `ui/tables.py` 既有的正確寫法。
body.en: When checking usage progress in the status line, token values near unit boundaries no longer display an awkward `1000k`. ⟦This awkwardness is like a car odometer that should flip to 1 kilometer at 999.5 meters, but instead displays 1000 meters due to early rounding; readjusting the threshold ensures the larger unit takes over right on time.⟧ Previously, the three status line scripts only upgraded to `M` when reaching 1,000,000, but `k` used integer formatting, causing values of 999,500 and above to round up to `1000k` first; the scripts also lacked a `B` step, causing 1.5 billion to be printed as `1500.0M`. The thresholds now compare against rounded boundaries (999,500 for `k` to `M`, 999,950,000 for `M` to `B`) and add the `B` step, matching the existing correct implementation in `ui/tables.py`.

items.original: **Token counts no longer read `1000k` at a unit boundary.** The three statusline scripts promoted to `M` at `value >= 1_000_000`, but `k` is formatted `:.0f`, so anything from 999,500 rounded to `1000k` first; there was no `B` step either, so 1.5 billion read `1500.0M`. The thresholds now compare against the rounded boundary (999,500 for k→M, 999,950,000 for M→B) and a `B` step was added, matching the already-correct version in `ui/tables.py`.

title.zh-TW: 報表週趨勢長條支援懸停顯示，標註日期區間與花費
title.en: Report weekly trend bars support hover display, showing date ranges and costs

body.zh-TW: 打開用量報表查看每週趨勢長條時，滑鼠移過去現在會即時浮現日期區間與花費。⟦這有如專案白板上的進度橫條，湊近細看才能得知起訖日期與開銷明細，且剛進行三天的當週絕不會虛報成整整七天。⟧以前每列長條只標記 Token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數量，完全看不出那是哪一週、花了多少費用。新版在滑鼠懸停時補齊了具體時間與金額，顯示的日期區間也會嚴格限制在報表的實際範圍內，讓還沒過完的最後一週不會宣稱涵蓋七天、旁邊卻只有三天的數據。
body.en: When viewing weekly trend bars in the usage report, hovering over them now reveals their date range and cost. ⟦It is like a progress bar on a project whiteboard where looking closely reveals exact start and end dates and expense details, ensuring a current week with only three days is never falsely shown as a full seven days.⟧ Previously, each row only marked token counts, with no way to tell which week it was or how much it cost. The new version provides the exact timeframe and amount on hover, and clamps the displayed date range strictly to the report's actual span so an unfinished last week does not claim seven days next to three days of numbers.

items.original: **Weekly trend bars in the report show their date range and cost on hover.** Each row only carried a token count, with no way to tell which week it was or what it cost. The range is clamped to the report's actual span, so an unfinished last week does not claim seven days next to three days of numbers.

title.zh-TW: 報表洞察備忘改為方角無框，對齊全列填色風格
title.en: Insight notes in reports become square and borderless, matching full-row fill styling

body.zh-TW: 報表底部的洞察備忘（提供用量趨勢與分析提醒的備忘列），現在全面改為方角、無外框的淡色整列。它們原本是整個報表介面中最後一處還帶有外框的表面，帶有 8px 圓角與 3px 左側色條，現在已改為與報表其餘整列填色完全一致的視覺風格。⟦整張介面有如筆記本排版，當所有章節內容都已換成清爽的無框滿版底色時，最後一個帶有外框與側邊色條的便簽也同步抹平框線，讓整頁閱讀動線不再突兀。⟧
body.en: Insight notes at the bottom of the report are now entirely square, borderless tinted full rows. They were originally the last framed surfaces left across the entire report interface, featuring 8px rounded corners and a 3px left stripe, and have now been updated to match the visual style of the report's other full-row fills. ⟦The entire interface is like a notebook layout where, once all chapter contents have switched to clean borderless full-bleed background colors, the last sticky note with a border and side stripe also flattens its outlines so the reading flow across the page is no longer disjointed.⟧

items.original: **Insight notes in the report are square, borderless tinted rows.** They were the last framed surface left — 8px corners and a 3px left stripe — and now match the report's other full-row fills.

entries: **AI Talent Market.** The panel browsed a curated set of subagent personas and installed them into `~/.claude/agents/`. Claude Code has since built persona selection in itself, and the evidence against the pattern accumulated from the other side: the GPT Store showed what happens to a persona catalogue once the host platform ships its own, and three papers now report that a persona prefix measurably degrades a model's reasoning rather than sharpening it. The panel also carried the project's only vendored binary — `vendor/instate-cli`, built from a separate private project, fetched during release through a `INSTATE_CLI_TOKEN` secret that expired twice and silently shipped a 23 MB-lighter app with an empty panel. Removing the feature removes that whole chain: the checksum file, the fingerprint guard, the release upload/download dance, and the macOS-only carve-outs in the panel parity and theme-count scripts.

**AI Council.** A separate window ran a multi-round discussion between Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity, with a token estimate up front, consensus tallying, and read-only folder access. It was the largest subsystem in the project at roughly 3,600 lines across `discussion/`, and the thing it produced — the same question answered by two tools, side by side, ending in one pass — is something two terminal windows already do faster. A usage monitor is the wrong place to run conversations; the quota it spent was the quota it exists to protect. The parts are in git history if a stripped-down version is ever wanted.

title.zh-TW: 移除 AI 人才市場面板，簡化安裝與發版流程
title.en: Remove AI Talent Market panel and simplify installation and release workflows

body.zh-TW: 挑選現成的 AI 角色卡，不再需要獨立面板。⟦這就像在背包外硬加專用工具袋，原廠斷貨讓袋子成了空擺設；既然主袋本就自帶夾層，拆掉它不但減重也省去扣具保養。⟧專案正式移除了 AI 人才市場面板。該面板原本用來瀏覽精選的 subagent（子代理）角色卡並安裝至 `~/.claude/agents/` 目錄。隨著 Claude Code 內建角色選擇，加上 GPT Store 示範了平台自帶功能後的目錄命運，三篇論文也證實角色前綴會削弱推理。該面板還夾帶私有專案編譯出的唯一外部二進位檔 `vendor/instate-cli`，發版密鑰 `INSTATE_CLI_TOKEN` 曾兩度過期，悄悄出貨少了 23 MB 且面板全空的程式。移除該功能一併拆掉了校驗檔、指紋防呆、發版上傳下載流程，以及面板一致性與主題計數腳本中專屬 macOS 的特例。
body.en: Choosing ready-made AI persona cards no longer requires a dedicated panel. ⟦It is like attaching a dedicated tool pouch to the outside of a backpack only for the manufacturer to discontinue it into an empty ornament; since the main bag already comes with built-in compartments, removing it not only sheds weight but also saves buckle maintenance.⟧ The project officially removed the AI Talent Market panel. The panel was originally used to browse curated subagent persona cards and install them into the `~/.claude/agents/` directory. As Claude Code built persona selection directly into the platform, and the GPT Store demonstrated the fate of catalogs once the host platform ships its own features, three papers also confirmed that persona prefixes degrade reasoning. The panel also carried the project's only external binary compiled from a private project, `vendor/instate-cli`; its release secret `INSTATE_CLI_TOKEN` expired twice, silently shipping an app that was 23 MB lighter with an empty panel. Removing this feature also eliminated the checksum file, fingerprint guards, release upload and download workflows, and macOS-specific carve-outs in the panel parity and theme-count scripts.

items.original: **AI Talent Market.** The panel browsed a curated set of subagent personas and installed them into `~/.claude/agents/`. Claude Code has since built persona selection in itself, and the evidence against the pattern accumulated from the other side: the GPT Store showed what happens to a persona catalogue once the host platform ships its own, and three papers now report that a persona prefix measurably degrades a model's reasoning rather than sharpening it. The panel also carried the project's only vendored binary — `vendor/instate-cli`, built from a separate private project, fetched during release through a `INSTATE_CLI_TOKEN` secret that expired twice and silently shipped a 23 MB-lighter app with an empty panel. Removing the feature removes that whole chain: the checksum file, the fingerprint guard, the release upload/download dance, and the macOS-only carve-outs in the panel parity and theme-count scripts.

title.zh-TW: 移除 AI 圓桌討論視窗，回歸專注保護用量額度
title.en: Remove AI Council window and refocus on protecting usage quota

body.zh-TW: 想並排比較不同 AI 的回答，交給兩個終端機視窗處理得更快。專案正式移除了 AI 圓桌討論視窗。這項功能過去會在獨立視窗中，讓 Claude Code、Codex 與 Antigravity 進行多輪討論，開始前提供 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）預估、過程中計票共識，並支援唯讀資料夾存取。它是專案最大的子系統，在 `discussion/` 目錄佔了約 3,600 行程式碼。但它產出的成果，只是由兩款工具並排回答同一題且一次結束，開兩個終端機視窗早就更快。用量監控工具不該拿來跑對話，花掉的額度正是它存在所要保護的額度。若日後需要精簡版本，零件都仍完整留在 git 歷史紀錄中。⟦這種矛盾宛如行動電源上的電量螢幕，為了展示炫目動畫日夜長亮，耗盡的反而是出門在外最需要保留的備用電力。⟧
body.en: Comparing answers from different AI tools side by side is much faster when left to two terminal windows. The project officially removed the AI Council window. This feature previously ran multi-round discussions between Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity in a separate window, providing upfront token estimates, consensus tallying during the process, and read-only folder access. It was the project's largest subsystem, accounting for roughly 3,600 lines of code across the `discussion/` directory. Yet the output it produced was merely two tools answering the same question side by side in a single pass, which opening two terminal windows already achieved faster. A usage monitor should not be used to run conversations; the quota it consumed was the exact quota it exists to protect. If a stripped-down version is ever needed in the future, the parts remain fully intact in git history. ⟦This contradiction is like a battery indicator screen on a power bank that stays lit day and night to show flashy animations, draining the very backup power you need to preserve most when away from home.⟧
